app.name: PromptWizard
app.tagline: Analyze a prompt, ask what is missing, and rewrite it better.

language.unknown: the same language as the original prompt

cli.description: Analyze a prompt, ask the missing questions in one batch, and rewrite it better.
cli.epilog:
Examples:
  promptwizard "summarize this report"
  promptwizard --provider groq --lang en < prompt.txt
  promptwizard gui
  promptwizard providers

analysis.summary_ok: The prompt is already well specified.

change.clarity: Made the wording explicit where it was vague.
change.structure: Split the wall of text into labelled sections.
change.ambiguity: Replaced vague wording with concrete requirements.
change.missing_detail: Added the detail that was missing.
change.weak_phrasing: Rewrote the weak instructions as direct orders.
change.audience: Stated who the answer is for.
change.examples: Added a place for an example of the expected answer.
change.scope: Bounded the scope of the task.
change.tone: Set the tone of the answer.
change.context: Added the background the model was missing.
change.answers: Folded your answers into the prompt.

format.text: In what form should the answer come?
format.why: The output format is not specified, so the model has to guess it.
format.options: short summary | bullet list | table | code | free text

audience.why: The audience decides vocabulary and level of detail.

length.text: How long should the answer be?
length.why: Without a length limit the model writes either too much or too little.
length.options: one paragraph | a few paragraphs | one page | as short as possible

constraints.text: What must the answer avoid or respect?
constraints.why: Explicit constraints keep the answer inside the intended boundaries.
constraints.options: no jargon | facts only | no examples | must cite sources

examples.text: Can you give one example of the answer you expect?
examples.why: An example pins down the style far better than an adjective.

context.text: What is the background: who is it for, and what happens with the result?
context.why: Context removes assumptions the model would otherwise invent.

tone.text: What tone should the answer use?
tone.why: Tone is rarely specified, and the model then picks a neutral default.

clarity.title: The goal is not stated in one sentence
clarity.detail: State the outcome you want first; the rest of the instructions can hang off it.

structure.title: The prompt is one undifferentiated block
structure.detail: Split it into short labelled parts (task, context, constraints, format); a model reads sections more reliably than a wall of text.

ambiguity.title: Vague wording leaves room for several readings
ambiguity.detail: Replace words like something, some or etc with the concrete thing you mean.

missing_detail.title: Too little information to act on
missing_detail.detail: Add the specifics: what exactly, for whom, over what material, with what limits.

weak_phrasing.title: Instructions are phrased as wishes, not as tasks
weak_phrasing.detail: Turn maybe-you-could into a direct instruction; imperative phrasing is followed more reliably.

constraints.title: No constraints or limits are given
constraints.detail: Say what must be avoided, the maximum length, and any hard rule.

format.title: The expected output format is not specified
format.detail: Say whether you want prose, bullets, a table, JSON or code, and roughly how long.

audience.title: The audience is not specified
audience.detail: Name who reads the answer; it fixes vocabulary and the level of detail.

examples.title: No example of a good answer
examples.detail: One short example removes more ambiguity than a paragraph of adjectives.

scope.title: The scope of the task is unclear
scope.detail: State where the task starts and stops, and what is explicitly out of scope.

tone.title: The tone of the answer is unspecified
tone.detail: Say whether the answer should be formal, neutral or friendly.

context.title: The background is missing
context.detail: Explain why you need the answer and what will be done with it.

gui.title: PromptWizard
gui.prompt_placeholder: Paste the prompt you want to improve...
gui.analysis_hint: What is weak in the prompt, and how to fix it
gui.questions_hint: Answer what you can; empty answers are fine
gui.prompt_hint: Type or paste the prompt, then press Analyze. The questions and the rewrite come next.
gui.no_questions: The prompt is specified well enough, so there is nothing to ask. Press Rewrite.

config.range: A configuration value is out of range. Check temperature (0-2), timeout (>0), max_tokens (>0) and max_questions (0-20).
config.read: The configuration file could not be read. Check that the path exists and is readable.
config.write: The configuration file could not be written. Check the directory permissions.
config.invalid: The configuration file is not valid JSON with an object at the top level.
config.open: Could not open the config file in an editor; open it by hand.
config.preset: That model preset is not defined in config.json. Add it under the models block.
config.autostart: Could not change the autostart entry.

provider.unreachable: The provider {provider} could not be reached ({reason}). Check your network, or start the local server (for example: ollama serve).
provider.timeout: The provider {provider} did not answer within {timeout}s. Raise --timeout or try a smaller model.
provider.auth: The provider {provider} rejected the credentials. Check that {env_var} is a valid API key.
provider.rate_limit: The provider {provider} reported a rate limit or an exhausted quota. Wait a moment, or switch provider with --provider.
provider.server: The provider {provider} returned a server error. This is usually temporary; retry in a moment.
provider.bad_request: The provider {provider} rejected the request. It often means the model id is wrong; check it in the provider dashboard.
provider.model_not_found: The model or endpoint was not found for {provider}. Check the model id, or run: promptwizard providers.
provider.bad_response: The provider {provider} returned a response this client could not parse.
provider.http: The provider {provider} returned an unexpected status ({status}).
provider.ollama_pull: The model {model} is not available locally. Run: ollama pull {model}
provider.no_model: No model is configured for {provider}. Set one with --model or in config.json.
provider.no_base_url: No base_url is configured for {provider}. Set one with --base-url or in config.json.
provider.missing_key: No API key found for {provider}. Set the {env_var} environment variable, or put it in a .env file.

storage.read: The session history could not be read.
storage.write: The session history could not be written. Check the permissions of the PromptWizard home directory.
